notes.ciFactors: Per-metric override of ciNoiseFactor, derived from measurement, not guessed. Two dispatched perf runs on macos-latest measured incrementalScan10kNotesMs at 3615 ms and 1168 ms (2026-09-07, runs 34144782352 and 34145006587) against 371 ms on the developer's M-series Mac: a 3x spread between consecutive runs of a cold, IO-bound scan on a shared runner. No threshold at factor 2 both catches a regression and survives an unlucky run, and a gate that fires on noise gets ignored. Factor 6 (9000 ms) sits 2.5x above the worst observed run, so it still catches a catastrophic regression while the real 1500 ms budget stays the number that describes the product. perf-budget.mjs flags any value over the raw budget even when the CI threshold passes, so the loose gate never hides the truth. Revisit when the app-side rows land (Spike C).
